zh: 第二天一早，胡雪岩悄悄到梅家弄把王有龄接回船。这位王大老爷春风满面，步履轻快，大家都道他异乡遇故，快谈竟夕，才有这份轻松的情绪，谁也不知道他微服私行，比起三多堂的喧闹轰饮，另有一番屋小如舟，春深似海的旖旎风光。这天开始要办正事了，王有龄把周、吴两委员请了来，连胡雪岩一起，先作个商量。他原定这一天上午去拜客，胡雪岩主张不必亟亟。“今天中午，尤老五和张胖子出面，请‘三大’的人吃饭，放款的事一谈好，通裕的米，随即可以拨借。”他说：“雪公，索性再等一等，也不会太久，一两天工夫，等我们自己这里办妥了再说。”“这样好！”周委员首先表示赞成，“到明后天，王大人去拜这里的按察使，那就直接谈交兑漕米了，差使显得更漂亮。”“好！我听你们的主意。”王有龄欣然同意。
en: Early the next morning, Hu quietly went to Meijia Lane and brought Wang back to the boat. His Honour was radiant and light of step. Everyone supposed that a reunion with an old acquaintance far from home, followed by a whole night of pleasant conversation, accounted for his cheerful ease. Nobody knew that his discreet excursion in ordinary clothes had offered pleasures quite unlike the noisy drinking at Sanduo Hall: a room as small as a boat, with spring's enchantment as deep as the sea. Serious work was to begin that day. Wang summoned Zhou and Wu for a preliminary discussion with Hu. He had intended to pay his calls that morning, but Hu thought there was no need to hurry. “At noon, You and Zhang are entertaining the men from the Big Three. Once the loan is settled, Tongyu can immediately advance the rice. Mr Xuexuan, wait a little longer. It won't take much time—a day or two. Let us put our own arrangements in order first.” “Excellent!” Zhou was the first to agree. “When you call on the judicial commissioner tomorrow or the day after, you can discuss delivery of the grain directly. The assignment will look all the better.” “Very well. I'll take your advice,” Wang readily agreed.

zh: “中午的饭局，不请周、吴两公了。”胡雪岩说第二件事，“商人总是怕官的，有周、吴两公在座，怕‘三大’的人拘束……”“不错，不错！”周委员抢着说道，“你无须解释。”“不过有件大事要请周、吴两公费心，‘民折官办’的这道手续，马上就要办一办。公事上我不懂，雪公看怎么处置？”“那要奉托两位了。”王有龄看着他们说：“两位是熟手，一定错不了。该我山面的，尽管请吩咐！“于是周、吴二人相视沉吟，似乎都有些茫然不知如何着手的样子。胡雪岩等了一会，看他们很为难，忍不住又说了，“我看这件事，公文上说不清楚，得有一位回杭州去当面禀陈。”“对了！”吴委员抚掌接口，“我也是这么想。当然，公文还是要的，只不过简单说一说，‘民折官办’一案，十分顺手，特饬某某人回省面禀请示云云。这样就可以了。”
en: “We won't ask you two gentlemen to the luncheon,” Hu continued. “Merchants are always nervous of officials. With you both present, the Big Three might feel constrained...” “Quite right!” Zhou interrupted. “No explanation is needed.” “But there is an important matter on which we need your help. The paperwork for cash payment by the taxpayer and official procurement must be dealt with at once. I know little of official procedure. What do you suggest, Mr Xuexuan?” “We must leave that to you two,” Wang said, looking at them. “You're experienced men and won't go wrong. If anything requires my intervention, just tell me.” Zhou and Wu exchanged thoughtful glances, both apparently uncertain where to begin. Hu waited a moment, then could not refrain from helping. “I don't think this can be explained clearly in a document. One of you ought to return to Hangzhou and report in person.” “Exactly!” Wu clapped his hands. “That was my thought too. Of course a document is still needed, but it can simply state that the official-procurement arrangement is proceeding favourably and that so-and-so has been specially ordered back to the provincial capital to report and seek instructions. That will do.”

zh: “那好！两位之中，哪一位辛苦一趟？”这一向，周、吴二人又迟疑了。甫到繁华之地，不能尽兴畅游，心里十分不愿。而且这一案的内容十分复杂，上面有所垂询，不能圆满解释，差使就算砸了。畏难之念一起，更不敢自告奋勇。“怎么？”王有龄有些不悦，“看样子只好我自己回去一趟了。”“那没有这个道理。”周委员很惶恐他说，“我去，我去！”看周委员有了表示，吴委员倒也不好意思了，“自然是我去。”他说。两个人争是在争，其实谁也不愿意去，王有龄不愿硬派，便说，“这样吧，我们掣签！”“不必了！”周委员很坚决他说，“决定我去。吴兄文章好，留在这里帮大人料理公事。我今天下午就走，尽快回来复命。”
en: “Good. Which of you will undertake the journey?” At this question, both hesitated again. They had only just reached this prosperous city and were most unwilling to leave before enjoying it fully. Besides, the affair was complicated. If their superiors asked questions they could not answer satisfactorily, the mission would be a failure. Once this apprehension arose, neither dared volunteer. “Well?” Wang was displeased. “It seems I shall have to go back myself.” “That would never do,” Zhou said in alarm. “I'll go.” Now that Zhou had spoken, Wu felt embarrassed too. “Naturally, I should go,” he said. They competed for the duty, though neither wanted it. Unwilling to impose a choice, Wang said, “Then let us draw lots.” “No need!” Zhou declared firmly. “It's settled: I'll go. Brother Wu writes well and should stay to help Your Honour with the documents. I'll leave this afternoon and return to report as soon as possible.”

zh: “也不必这么急。”胡雪岩作了个诡秘的微笑，“今天晚上我替周老爷饯行。明天动身好了。”“雪岩兄的话不错。公事虽然紧要，也不争在这半天工夫。”吴委员也说，“晚上替周兄饯行，我跟雪岩兄一起作主人。”王有龄也表示从容些的好，并且颇有嘉勉之词，暗示将来叙功的“保案”中，一定替周委员格外说好话，作为酬庸。自告奋勇的收获，可说相当丰富。
en: “There's no need for such haste.” Hu gave a knowing smile. “I'll give you a farewell dinner tonight. You can leave tomorrow.” “Brother Xueyan is right,” Wu agreed. “Important though the business is, half a day won't matter. He and I will jointly entertain Brother Zhou tonight.” Wang too favoured a more leisurely departure. He praised Zhou warmly and hinted that, when recommendations for rewards were submitted, he would speak particularly well of him. Volunteering had yielded a considerable return.

zh: 为了周委员回杭州，那个庶务却是大忙而特忙，第一要雇船，照周委员的意思，最好坐原来的那只“无锡快”，由阿珠一路伺奉着来回。但那只船名“快”而实不快，只宜于晚开早到，多泊少走，玩赏风景之用，赶路要另雇双桨奇快的“水上飞”。第二件更麻烦，也是胡雪岩的建议，杭州抚、藩、臬三大宪，加上粮道，还有各衙门有关系的文案、幕友，都应该有一份礼。“十里夷场”，奇珍异物无数，会选的花费不多而受者惬意，不会的，花了大价钱却不起眼，变成“俏眉眼做给瞎子看”，因此，备办这十几份礼物，不是一件轻松的差使。胡雪岩主意，请尤老五派个人，带着那庶务和高升，到“夷场”上外国人所开最大的一家洋行“亨达利”去采办。
en: Zhou's return to Hangzhou kept the general affairs officer exceptionally busy. First, a boat had to be hired. Zhou would have preferred one of their original fast Wuxi boats, with A'zhu serving him on the outward and return journeys. But these boats were fast only in name. They were suited to late departures, early arrivals, frequent stops, and leisurely sightseeing. For speed, he needed a different vessel, a double-oared “water flyer.” The second task was more troublesome, and again Hu's idea. Gifts were due to the governor, treasurer, and judicial commissioner in Hangzhou, to the grain intendant, and to the relevant secretaries and advisers in their offices. The foreign settlement, stretching for miles, offered countless rare and curious objects. A skilful buyer could please the recipient at little cost; an unskilful one might spend a fortune on something that attracted no notice, wasting his charms on a blind man. Choosing these dozen or more gifts was no easy assignment. Hu decided to ask You for a guide to take the general affairs officer and Gao to Hengdali, the largest foreign trading house in the settlement, to make their purchases.

zh: 这天人人有事，王有龄和周、吴二人在船上办文稿，开节略，把此行的经过，如何繁难吃力，而又如何圆满妥帖，字斟句酌地叙了进去。胡雪岩和张胖子的任务，自然更重要，中午与尤老五请“三大”的档手，在英租界的“番菜馆”赴宴谈生意。结果生意不曾在番菜馆谈，因为照例要“叫局”，莺莺燕燕一大堆，不是谈生意的时候。饭罢一起到城隍庙后花园钱业公所品茗，这时张胖子才提到正事。“三大”之中，大亨钱庄姓孙的档手资格最老，他代代表发言，首先就表示最近银根很紧，“局势不好，有钱的人都要把现银子捏在手里，怕放了倒帐。这句实在话，钱庄本来是空的。”这是照例有的托词，银根紧的理由甚多，不妨随意编造，目的就在抬高利息。张胖子和胡雪岩都懂这个道理，尤老五却以受过上海钱庄的气，怀有成见，大为不快。
en: Everyone had work to do that day. Wang, Zhou, and Wu remained aboard drafting reports and summaries, carefully weighing every word to show how difficult the assignment had been and how thoroughly and satisfactorily they had carried it out. Hu and Zhang naturally had still more important duties. At noon they joined You in entertaining the managers of the Big Three at a Western restaurant in the British concession, where they intended to discuss business. In the event, no business was discussed there. Courtesans were summoned as usual, and with so many women around, the occasion was unsuitable. After lunch, the party went for tea to the bankers' guildhall in the garden behind the City God Temple. Only then did Zhang raise the matter. Of the three banks, Daheng's manager, Sun, had the greatest seniority. Speaking for them all, he began by saying that money was very tight. “The outlook is poor. People with money want to keep the silver in their own hands, fearing bad debts if they lend it. Frankly, a bank has little money of its own.” This was the customary excuse. There were endless reasons for tight money, any of which could be invented to push up the interest. Zhang and Hu understood perfectly. You, however, had suffered at the hands of Shanghai bankers before and was already prejudiced against them. He was deeply displeased.

zh: “我看不是银根紧，只怕是借的人招牌不硬，”他的话有棱角，态度却极好，是半带着开玩笑的语气说的，“漕帮现在倒霉，要是‘沙船帮’的郁老大开口，银根马上就松了。”尤老五说的这个人是沙船帮的巨擘，名叫郁馥山，拥有上百艘的沙船，北走关东，南走闽粤，照海洋的方位，称为“北洋”、“南洋”，郁馥山就以走南北洋起家，是上海县的首富。近年因为漕米海运，更是大发利市，新近在小南门造了一所巨宅，崇楼杰阁，参以西法，算是“海天旭日”、“黄浦秋涛”等等“沪城八景”以外的另一景。沙船帮与漕帮，本来海永不犯河水，但漕运改了新章，使有了极厉害的利害冲突，所以尤老五那句话斤两很重，姓孙的有些吃不消。“啊，尤五哥，”姓孙的惶恐地说，“你这话，我们一个字也不敢承认。吝户都是一样的，论到交情，尤五哥的面子更加不同。好了，今天就请尤五哥吩咐！“
en: “I doubt it's the money that's tight. Perhaps the borrower's name isn't good enough.” His words had an edge, but his manner remained amiable, almost joking. “Our association is down on its luck. If Boss Yu of the sand-junk association asked, the money would loosen at once.” He meant Yu Fushan, a leading shipowner who possessed more than a hundred sand junks. They sailed north to Manchuria and south to Fujian and Guangdong, on routes known by their maritime positions as the Northern and Southern Seas. Yu had made his fortune on those routes and become the richest man in Shanghai County. The recent shift of grain shipments to the sea had brought him still greater profits. Near the Little South Gate he had lately built a vast residence, with imposing towers and halls incorporating Western methods. It counted as another sight to be set beside Shanghai's celebrated Eight Views, such as “Sunrise over Sea and Sky” and “Autumn Waves on the Huangpu.” The sand-junk men and the canal association had once kept to their separate waters, but the new grain-transport arrangements had brought their interests into sharp conflict. You's remark therefore carried considerable weight. Sun found it difficult to answer. “Brother You,” he said anxiously, “we cannot accept a single word of that. All clients are treated alike. As for friendship, your standing with us is exceptional. Very well: tell us what you require today.”

zh: 象尤老五这样在江湖上有地位的，轻易说不得一句重话，刚才话中有牢骚，已不够漂亮，此刻听姓孙的这样回答，更显得自己那句话带着要挟威胁的意味，越觉不安，所以急忙抱拳笑道：“言重，言重！全靠各位帮忙。”张胖子总归是站在同行这方面的，而且自己也有担保的责任，心里在想，姓孙的吃不消尤老五，说到“请吩咐”的话，未免冒失！如果凭一句话草草成局，以后一出麻烦，吃亏的心是钱庄，自己也会连带受累。由于这样的了解，他不希望他们讲江湖义气，愿意一板一眼谈生意，不过他的话也很圆到，“大家都是自己人，尤五哥更是好朋友，没有谈不通的事，”他说，“ ‘三大，愿意帮忙，尤老哥一定也不会叫’三大‘吃亏。是不是？”尤老五当然听得出他话中的意思，立即接口：“一点不错！江湖归江湖，生意归生意。我看这样，”他望着胡雪岩说，“小爷叔，这件事让张老板跟孙老板他们去谈，应该怎么样就怎么样，我无不照办，我们就不必在场了。”胡雪岩听他这一说，暗暗佩服，到底是一帮的老大，做事实在漂亮。于是欣然答道：“对，对！我也正有事要跟五哥谈。”说着，两人相偕起身，向那几个钱庄朋友点一点头，到另外一张桌子去吃茶，让张胖子全权跟“三大”谈判。
en: A man of You's standing could not lightly speak harshly. The resentment in his earlier remark had already fallen short of proper grace. Sun's answer now made it sound positively coercive, and You was still more uneasy. He hastily clasped his hands and smiled. “You are too kind. I rely entirely on your help.” Zhang ultimately stood with his fellow bankers, and he too bore responsibility for the guarantee. Sun's inability to withstand You had led him rashly to offer to do whatever was asked. If a transaction were concluded on the strength of one remark and trouble arose later, the banks would suffer, and Zhang would be involved as well. He therefore preferred straightforward business negotiation to appeals to brotherhood, though he expressed himself tactfully. “We're all friends here, and Brother You is a particularly good one. Nothing is beyond agreement. The Big Three are willing to help, and Brother You certainly won't let them lose by it. Isn't that so?” You immediately understood. “Exactly. Friendship is one thing, business another. Here's my suggestion.” He looked at Hu. “Young Uncle, let Mr Zhang discuss it with Mr Sun and the others. Whatever terms are proper, I'll accept. There's no need for us to stay.” Hu privately admired him. He was indeed the leader of an association and knew how to handle things handsomely. “Yes,” he readily answered. “I have something to discuss with you as well.” They rose together, nodded to the bankers, and moved to another table, leaving Zhang full authority to negotiate.

zh: “小爷叔！”尤老五首先表明，“借款是另外一回事，通裕垫米又是一回事，桥归桥，路归路。米，我已经叫通裕启运了，在哪里交兑，你们要不要派人，还是统通由我代办？请你交代下来，我三天工夫替你们办好。”“好极了！五哥跟老太爷这样放交情，我现在也不必说什么！‘路遥知马力，日久见人心‘，将来就晓得了。“胡雪岩接着又说，”在哪里交兑，等我问明白了来回报五哥。要不要另外派人，公事上我不大懂，也要回去问一问。如果我好作主，当然拜托五哥，辛苦弟兄们替我办一办。““好的，就这样说定了，我关照通裕老顾去伺候，王大老爷有什么话，尽管交代他。”一件有关浙江地方大吏前程的大事，就这样三言两语作了了结。胡雪岩还有件要紧事要请尤老五帮忙。
en: “Young Uncle,” You began, “the loan is one matter; Tongyu's advance of rice is another. Let each stand on its own. I've already ordered Tongyu to begin shipping. Where is the delivery to be made? Will you send someone, or shall I handle it all? Give me your instructions, and I'll have it done in three days.” “Excellent! With you and the old master showing us such friendship, there's no need for more words now. A long road tests a horse's strength; time reveals a man's heart. You'll see in future.” Hu continued, “I'll find out where the rice is to be delivered and report back. Whether we must send someone separately is an official detail I don't understand; I must ask about that too. If it were mine to decide, I would naturally entrust it to you and trouble the brethren to handle it for me.” “Good. Then it's settled. I'll tell Gu at Tongyu to attend upon you. His Honour Wang can give him whatever instructions are needed.” An affair upon which the careers of Zhejiang's senior officials depended was thus settled in a few words. Hu still had another important request.

zh: “五哥，我还有个麻烦要靠你想办法。”他放低了声音说：“我有两万银子要汇到福建，不能叫人知道，你有什么办法？”尤老五沉吟了一会问道：“是现银，还是庄票？”“自然是庄票。”“那容易得很。”尤老五很随便地说：“你自己写封信，把庄票封在里面，我找个人替你送到，拿回信回来。你看怎么样？”“那这样太好了。”胡雪岩又问：“不晓得要几天工夫？”“不过五六天工夫。”胡雪岩大为惊异：“这么快？”“我托火轮船上的人去办。”
en: “Brother You, there's another difficulty I need your help with.” He lowered his voice. “I have twenty thousand taels to remit to Fujian without anyone knowing. Can you arrange it?” You considered. “Is it silver, or a bank draft?” “A draft, naturally.” “Then it's very easy,” You said casually. “Write a letter yourself and enclose the draft. I'll find someone to deliver it and bring back a reply. Would that suit?” “That would be ideal. How long would it take?” “Only five or six days.” Hu was astonished. “So quickly?” “I'll ask someone aboard a steamship to do it.”

zh: 从道光十五年起，英国第一艘“渣甸号”开到，东南沿海便有了轮船。不久为了禁鸦片开仗，道光二十一年辛丑七月，英国军队攻陷镇江，直逼江宁，运了大炮安置在钟山，预备轰城。朝廷大震，决计议和，派出耆英、伊里布和两江总督牛鉴为“全权大臣”，与英国公使谈和，订立和约十三条，赔军费，割香港，开广州、厦门、福州、宁波、上海力通商口岸，称为“五口通商”，大英公司的轮船，源源而至，从上海到福州经常有班轮，但一路停靠宁波、温州，来回要半个月的工夫，何以说是只要五六天？胡雪岩越发不解。“我到英国使馆去想办法，他们有直放的轮船。”
en: Steamships had appeared off the southeastern coast since the arrival of the first British vessel, the Jardine, in the fifteenth year of the Daoguang reign. Soon afterwards, the suppression of opium led to war. In the seventh month of the twenty-first Daoguang year, the xinchou year, British troops captured Zhenjiang and pressed towards Jiangning. They transported cannon to Zhongshan, preparing to bombard the city. The court was deeply alarmed and decided to negotiate peace. It appointed Qiying, Yilibu, and the Governor-General of Liangjiang, Niu Jian, as plenipotentiaries to negotiate with the British representative. A treaty of thirteen articles provided for a war indemnity, the cession of Hong Kong, and the opening of Guangzhou, Xiamen, Fuzhou, Ningbo, and Shanghai to trade: the opening of the five treaty ports. Steamships of the British company came in increasing numbers. Regular vessels sailed between Shanghai and Fuzhou, but with stops at Ningbo and Wenzhou, the round trip took half a month. How could You promise five or six days? Hu was more puzzled than ever. “I'll arrange it through the British mission,” You explained. “They have ships that sail directly.”

zh: “噢！”是一声简单的答语，可是胡雪岩心里却是思潮起伏，第一觉得外国人的花样厉害，飘洋过海，不当回事，做生意就是要靠运货方便，别人用老式船，我用新式船，抢在人家前面运到，自然能卖得好价钱。火轮船他也见过，靠在码头上象座仓库，装的东西一定不少，倒不妨好好想一想，用轮船来运货，说不定可以发大财。其次，他发觉尤老五的路子极广，连外国使馆都能打得通，并且这个人做事爽快，应该倾心结交，将来大有用处。这样一想，便放出全副本领来跟尤老五周旋，两个人谈得十分投机。他把与王有龄的关系，作了适当的透露。尤老五觉得此人也够得上“侠义”二字，而且肯说到这种情形，完全是以自己人相看，因而原来奉师命接待的，这时变成自己愿意帮他的忙了。
en: “Oh!” It was a simple answer, but Hu's mind was busy. First, he was struck by the effectiveness of foreign methods. They thought nothing of crossing seas. Business depended upon convenient transport. If others used old vessels while he used new ones, his goods could arrive first and naturally command a better price. He had seen steamships: moored at the landing, they looked like warehouses and must carry enormous quantities. The idea deserved thought. Shipping goods by steamer might make a great fortune. Second, he realised how extensive You's connections were. He could even reach the foreign mission, and he acted promptly and generously. Hu ought to cultivate him wholeheartedly; the connection could be immensely useful. With that in mind, he employed all his skill in conversation, and they got on exceedingly well. He disclosed an appropriate amount about his relationship with Wang. You felt that this man deserved to be called chivalrous. To speak so openly also showed that Hu regarded him entirely as one of his own. What had begun as hospitality offered at his master's command now became a personal willingness to help.

zh: 这面谈得忘掉了时间！那面的钱庄朋友，却已有了成议，由通裕出面来借，“三大”和张胖子一共贷放十万两银子，以三个月为期，到期可以转一转，尤老五和胡雪岩做保，却有一个条件要王有龄答应，这笔借款没有还清以前，浙江海运局在上海的公款汇划，要归三大承办，这是一种变相保证的意思。“用不着跟王大老爷去说。”胡雪岩这样答复，“我就可以代为答应。”“利息呢？”尤老五问。“利息是这样，”张胖子回头看了看那面“三大”的人，低了声说道：“年息一分一照算。”“这不算贵。”尤老五说。人家是漂亮话，胡雪岩要结交尤老五，便接口说道：“也不算便宜！”
en: At their table, conversation made them forget the time. At the other, the bankers had reached agreement. Tongyu would be the borrower. The Big Three and Zhang would together lend a hundred thousand taels for three months, with the possibility of renewal. You and Hu would act as guarantors. There was, however, one condition requiring Wang's consent: until the loan was repaid, all remittances of the Zhejiang Sea Transport Bureau's public funds in Shanghai must be handled by the Big Three. This amounted to an indirect form of security. “There's no need to ask His Honour,” Hu answered. “I can agree on his behalf.” “And the interest?” You asked. “As for interest...” Zhang glanced back at the men from the Big Three, then lowered his voice. “The stated annual rate is eleven per cent.” “That isn't expensive,” You said. It was a gracious response. Wishing to strengthen his friendship with You, Hu added, “Nor is it cheap!”

zh: 张胖子很厉害，他下面还有句话，起先故意不说，这时察言观色，不说不可，便故意装作埋怨的神气：“你们两位不要性急！我话还没有完，实在是这个数！”说着伸开食拇两指扬了扬。“八厘？”胡雪岩问。“不错，八厘。另外三厘是你们两位做保应得的好处。”“不要把我算在里头。”胡雪岩抢着说道，“我的一份归五哥。”“小爷叔，你真够朋友！不过我更加不可以在这上面‘戴帽子’。这样，”尤老五转脸问张胖子，“你的一份呢？”“我？”张胖子笑道，“我是放款的，与我什么相干？”“话不是这么说。张老板，我也知道，你名为老板，实在也是伙计，说句不客气的话，‘皇帝不差饿兵’，我要顾到你的好处。不过这趟是苦差使，我准定借三个月，利息算九厘，明八暗一，这一厘算我们的好处，送了给你。”“这怎么好意思？”“不必客气了。”胡雪岩完全站在尤老五这面说话，“我们什么时候成契？”
en: Zhang was shrewd. He had deliberately withheld something. Now, reading their expressions, he knew he must disclose it. Pretending to reproach them, he said, “Don't be impatient, you two! I haven't finished. The real figure is this.” He extended his thumb and forefinger. “Eight per cent?” Hu asked. “Exactly. The other three percentage points are the benefit due to you two for guaranteeing the loan.” “Leave me out,” Hu said at once. “My share goes to Brother You.” “Young Uncle, you're a true friend. But I have still less right to put a surcharge on top. Tell me, Mr Zhang,” You continued, turning to him, “where is your share?” “Mine?” Zhang laughed. “I'm the lender. What has that to do with me?” “That's not the way to look at it. I know that, although you're called the boss, you too are really an employee. To speak plainly, even the emperor doesn't send hungry soldiers on an assignment. I must consider your interests. This has been a difficult job. I'll undertake to borrow for the full three months. Make the interest nine per cent: eight openly, one privately. Treat that extra point as our benefit, which we give to you.” “How could I accept?” “No need for ceremony,” Hu said, entirely supporting You. “When shall we sign the agreement?”

zh: “明天吧！”就这样说定局，约定了第二天下午仍旧这里碰面，随即分手。张胖子跟“三大”的人还有话谈，胡雪岩一个人回去，把经过情形一说，王有龄和周、吴二人，兴奋非凡，自然也把胡雪岩赞扬不绝。避开闲人，胡雪岩又把汇款到福建的事，跟王有龄悄悄说了一遍。他皱着眉笑道，“雪岩，事情这么顺利，我反倒有些担心了。”“担心什么？”“担心会出什么意外。凡事物极必反，乐极生悲。”“那在于自己。”胡雪岩坦率答道：“我是不大相信这一套的。有什么意外，都因为自己这个不够用的缘故。”说着，他敲敲自己的太阳穴。“不错！”王有龄又说，“雪岩，你的脑筋好，想想看，还有什么该做而没有做的事？”“你要写两封信，一封写给黄抚台，一封写给何学使。”“对，我马上动手。”
en: “Tomorrow?” So it was settled. They agreed to meet at the same place the following afternoon, then parted. Zhang had more to discuss with the Big Three. Hu returned alone and reported what had happened. Wang, Zhou, and Wu were delighted and naturally praised him without restraint. Away from other ears, Hu quietly explained the arrangements for the Fujian remittance. Wang smiled with a crease in his brow. “Xueyan, everything is going so smoothly that I'm beginning to worry.” “About what?” “Some unexpected mishap. When things reach an extreme, they turn the other way. Too much joy brings sorrow.” “That depends on us,” Hu answered frankly. “I don't put much faith in such sayings. Unexpected trouble usually comes because this isn't working well enough.” He tapped his temple. “True,” Wang said. “You have a good head, Xueyan. Think: is there anything we ought to have done but haven't?” “You should write two letters: one to Governor Huang, one to Education Commissioner He.” “Yes. I'll begin at once.”

zh: 当夜胡雪岩跟吴委员在三多堂替周委员饯行，第二趟来，虽算熟客，“长三”的规矩，也还不到“住夜厢”的时候，但尤老五的朋友，情形特殊，周、吴二人当夜就都做了三多堂的入幕之宾。第二天王有龄才去拜客，先拜地主上海知县，打听总办江浙漕米海运，已由江苏臬司调为藩司的倪良耀，是否在上海？据说倪良耀一直不曾回苏州，公馆设在天后宫，于是转道天后宫，用手本谒见。倪良耀是个老实人，才具却平常，为了漕米海运虽升了官，却搞得焦头烂额。黄宗汉参了他一本，说他办事糊涂，而且把家眷送到杭州暂住，所以谕旨上责备他说：“当军务倥偬之际，辄将眷属迁避邻省，致令民心惶惑，咎实难解，乃犹以绕道回籍探访老母为词，何居心若是巧诈？”为此，他见了王有龄大发牢骚，反把正事搁在一边。
en: That evening Hu and Wu gave Zhou a farewell dinner at Sanduo Hall. On a second visit they counted as familiar patrons, but under the conventions of a changsan establishment, it was still too soon for an overnight stay. You's friends, however, were an exception. Both commissioners were admitted that night to their hosts' inner chambers. Wang did not pay his calls until the following day. He first visited the local magistrate of Shanghai and asked whether Ni Liangyao, director-general of the Jiangsu and Zhejiang sea grain shipments, who had been transferred from judicial commissioner to provincial treasurer of Jiangsu, was in the city. He learned that Ni had not returned to Suzhou and had established his residence at the Temple of the Queen of Heaven. Wang therefore went there and presented his official visiting card. Ni was an honest man of ordinary ability. Sea transport had gained him a promotion but left him overwhelmed. Huang had impeached him for muddling his duties and sending his family to stay temporarily in Hangzhou. An imperial edict rebuked him: “At a time of pressing military affairs, you summarily moved your dependants to a neighbouring province, causing alarm and uncertainty among the people. Your fault is difficult to excuse. Yet you plead that you were merely making a detour to your native district to visit your aged mother. Why are your intentions so deceitful?” Ni therefore greeted Wang with a torrent of complaints, pushing their official business aside.

zh: 王有龄从胡雪岩那里学到了许多圆滑的手法，听得他的牢骚，不但没有不豫之色，而且极表同情。提到家眷，他又问住处，拍胸应承，归他照料。“你老哥如此关顾，实在感激。”倪良耀说的地真话，感激之情，溢于词色，“我也听人说起，你老哥是黄中丞面前，一等一的红人，除了敝眷要请照拂以外，黄中丞那里，也要请老哥鼎力疏通。”“不敢！不敢！”王有龄诚恳地答说，“凡有可以效劳之处，无不如命。”“唉！”倪良耀安慰之中有感慨，“都象老哥这样热心明白，事情就好办了。”有了这句话，公事就非常顺手了。提到交兑漕米余额，倪良耀表示完全听王有龄的意思，他会交代所属，格外予以方便。接着，他又大叹苦经，说是明知道黄宗汉所奏，浙江漕米如数竟足这句话不实，他却不敢据买奏复，辩一辩真相，讲一讲道理，原因是惹不起黄宗汉。
en: Wang had learned much tact from Hu. Instead of showing displeasure at Ni's complaints, he expressed deep sympathy. When the family was mentioned, he asked where they lived and confidently promised to look after them. “I am truly grateful for your concern,” Ni said, his sincerity evident in both voice and expression. “I've heard that you are Governor Huang's foremost favourite. Besides asking you to look after my family, I must beg your help in smoothing matters over with him.” “You are too kind,” Wang answered earnestly. “Wherever I can be of service, I shall do everything you ask.” “Ah!” Ni felt both comforted and moved. “If everyone were as helpful and understanding as you, things would be easy.” After that, their official business went very smoothly. When Wang mentioned delivering the outstanding grain, Ni said he would follow Wang's wishes entirely and instruct his subordinates to give him every assistance. Then he returned to his troubles. He knew Huang's memorial claiming full delivery of Zhejiang's grain was untrue, yet dared not report the facts, defend his position, or argue the point. He could not afford to offend Huang.

zh: “黄中丞这一科——道兴十五年乙未，科运如日方中，不说别的，拿江苏来说，何学使以外，还有许中丞，都是同年。京里除了彭大军机，六部几乎都有人。他老哥替我想想，我到哪里去伸冤讲理？”“大人的劳绩，上头到底也知道的。吃亏就是便宜，大人存心厚道，后福方长。”倪良耀是老实人，对他这两句泛泛的慰词，亦颇感动，不断拱手说道：托福，找福！“主人并无送客之意，这算是抬举，王有龄不能不知趣，主动告辞，便又陪着倪良耀谈了些时局和人物，从他口中，得知何桂清捐输军饷，交部优叙奖励，也常有奏折，建议军务部署，朱笔批示，多所奖许，圣眷正隆。这些情形，在五有龄当然是极大的安慰。
en: “Governor Huang's examination cohort—the yiwei year, the fifteenth of Daoguang—is at the height of its influence. In Jiangsu alone, besides Education Commissioner He, Governor Xu belongs to it. In the capital, apart from Grand Councillor Peng, they have men in almost every ministry. Tell me, where could I go to have my grievance heard?” “Your service is known above, after all. What seems a loss may prove a gain. With your generous disposition, Your Excellency has many blessings ahead.” Ni was a simple, honest man and was moved even by these general words of consolation. Repeatedly clasping his hands, he said, “May your kind words prove true!” He showed no intention of ending the visit. That was an honour Wang could not ignore by taking his leave. He therefore stayed to discuss the political situation and various men in public life. From Ni he learned that He Guiqing had contributed to military funds and been referred to the appropriate board for generous recognition. He also frequently submitted memorials suggesting military arrangements and received favourable comments in vermilion. Imperial favour was strong. Naturally, all this greatly reassured Wang.

zh: 辞出天后宫，王有龄在轿子里回想此行的种种，无一事不是顺利得出乎意料之外，因而心里不免困惑，一个人到底是靠本事，还是靠运气？照胡雪岩的情形来说，完全是靠本事，想想自己的今天，似乎靠运气。这话也不对！他在想，胡雪岩本事通天，如果没有自己，此刻自是依然潦倒，怀才不遇的人，车载斗量，看来他也要靠运至于自己呢？如果不是从小习于吏事，以及这一趟从京师南下，好好看了些经世之学的名著，为黄宗汉所赏识，那么即使有天大的面子，也不过派上个能够捞几个钱的差使，黄宗汉决下会把浙江漕米海运的重任，托付给自己。照此一说，还是要有本事。有本事还要有机会，机会就是运气。想到这里，王有龄的困惑消失了，一个人要发达，也要本事，也要运气。李广不侯，是有本事没有运气，运气来了，没有本事，不过昙花一现，好景不长。现在是运气来了，要好好拿本事出来，本事在胡雪岩身上，把胡雪岩收服了，他的本事就变成了自己的本事。这样深一层去想，王有龄欣然大有领悟，原来一个人最大的本事就是能用人，用人又先要识人，眼光、手腕，两俱到家，才智之士，乐予为己所用，此人的成就便不得了了。由于这个了解，王有龄觉得用人的方法要变一变，应该恩威并用，特别是对胡雪岩，在感情以外，更加上权术、笼络之道，无微不至。
en: Leaving the temple, Wang reflected in his chair upon the journey. Everything had gone more smoothly than he could have expected. He found himself puzzled: did success depend upon ability or luck? Hu's achievements appeared entirely due to ability. His own position seemed the work of luck. Yet that was not right either. However capable Hu might be, without Wang he would still be in distress. There were countless talented men without opportunities. Hu too depended on fortune. And what of Wang himself? Had he not learned administrative affairs from childhood and studied important works on statecraft during his journey south from the capital, he would not have won Huang's appreciation. Even the strongest recommendation would merely have gained him some assignment from which he could make a little money. Huang would never have entrusted him with the weighty task of Zhejiang's sea grain transport. Ability, then, was necessary after all. But ability needed opportunity, and opportunity was luck. At that thought his confusion disappeared. Success required both. Li Guang had never become a marquis because he possessed ability without luck. Luck without ability would bring only a fleeting flowering of success. Now that fortune had arrived, Wang must make good use of ability. That ability lay in Hu. If he won Hu over, Hu's talents would become his own. Pursuing the thought, Wang reached a gratifying insight: a man's greatest ability was knowing how to employ others. Before employing them, he had to recognise their worth. With judgement and skill in handling people, he could make talented men willing to serve him, and his achievements would be immense. He therefore felt that his methods should change. Kindness must be combined with authority. Particularly with Hu, affection should be reinforced by political skill and the most attentive efforts to secure his allegiance.

zh: 半个月的工夫，一切公事都办得妥妥帖帖，该要回杭州了。王有龄了为犒劳部属，特设盛宴，宴罢宣布：“各位这一趟都辛苦了，难得到上海来一趟好好玩两天！今天四月初四，我们准定初七开船回杭州。”说完，从靴页子里取出一叠红封袋，上面标着名字，每人一个，连张胖子都不例外，封袋里面是一张银票，数目多寡不等，最多的是周委员那一个，一百两，最少的是那个庶务的，二十两。“这是‘杖头钱。”他掉了句文，’供各位看花买醉之需。“说到“看花”那就是“缠头资”了，周、吴二人已经发觉。阿珠成了胡雪岩的禁脔，不便问津，好在三多堂各有相好，有钱有工夫，乐得去住两天。“他也去逛一逛。”王有龄又对高升说，“我要到我亲戚那里去两天，放你的假吧！”高升也有一个红包，是二十两银子。托词到亲戚家住，其实是住在梅家弄。这个秘密，始终只有胡雪岩一个人知道。这一天晚上，王有龄约了他在畹香的妆阁小酌，有公事以外的“要紧话”要谈。半个月之中，王有龄来过四越，跟畹香已经打得火热，自己的身分也不再瞒她，这天要谈的话，就是关于畹香的。把她安排好了，王有龄还要替阿珠安排。
en: Within half a month, all their official business had been satisfactorily settled. It was time to return to Hangzhou. To reward his subordinates, Wang gave a lavish banquet. Afterwards he announced, “You've all worked hard on this journey. We don't often come to Shanghai, so enjoy yourselves for a couple of days. Today is the fourth day of the fourth month. We shall definitely sail for Hangzhou on the seventh.” From the inner flap of his boot he took a stack of red envelopes, each bearing a name. Everyone received one, Zhang included. Inside was a bank draft. The amounts varied: Zhou received the most, a hundred taels; the general affairs officer the least, twenty. “Money for the end of your travelling staff,” Wang said, using a literary expression. “To provide for admiring flowers and buying wine.” Admiring flowers meant paying courtesans. Zhou and Wu had already noticed that A'zhu was now regarded as Hu's exclusive concern and could no longer be approached. Fortunately, each had a favourite at Sanduo Hall. With both money and time, they were happy to spend two days there. “You should go and enjoy yourself too,” Wang told Gao, whose red envelope also held twenty taels. “I'm going to stay with my relative for two days. You may take leave.” The relative was an excuse. He was staying in Meijia Lane, a secret still known only to Hu. That evening he invited Hu to a quiet drink in Wanxiang's room. There were “important matters” beyond official business to discuss. In the past fortnight, Wang had visited four times, and their attachment had grown warm. He no longer concealed his identity. Wanxiang was the subject he wished to discuss. After arranging matters for her, he also intended to make arrangements for A'zhu.

zh: 他的心思，胡雪岩猜到一半，是关于畹香的，他心里已经有了一个主意，但觉得不宜冒失。先要探探畹香的口气，所以等一端起酒杯就说：“畹香，王大老爷要回去了。”一听这话，她的脸色马上变了，看上去眼圈发红，也不知她是做作还是真心？不过就算做作，也做得极象，离愁别恨，霎时间在脸上堆起，浓得化不开。“哪一天动身？”她问。“定了初七。”王有龄回答。“这么急！”畹香失声说道。“今天初四。”胡雪岩屈着手指说：“初五、初六、还有三天的工夫，也很从容了。你有什么话，尽管跟王大老爷说，”“我！”畹香把头扭了过去，“叫我说什么？我说了也没有用，办不到的！”“怎么呢？”胡雪岩逼进一层，“何以晓得办不到？”畹香把脸转了过来，皱着眉、闭着嘴，长长的睫毛不住眨动，是极为踌躇的样子，几次欲语又休，终于只是一声微喟，摇摇头，把一双耳环晃荡个不住。
en: Hu guessed half his intention: the part concerning Wanxiang. He already had an idea, but thought it unwise to act rashly. First he must sound her out. As soon as they raised their cups, he said, “Wanxiang, His Honour Wang is going home.” Her expression changed at once and her eyes appeared to redden. Whether this was acting or sincere feeling was impossible to tell. Even if acting, however, it was convincing: sorrow at their parting gathered on her face so thickly that it seemed impossible to dispel. “When are you leaving?” “The seventh,” Wang answered. “So soon!” she exclaimed. “Today is the fourth.” Hu counted on his fingers. “The fifth, the sixth—there are still three days. Plenty of time. If you have anything to say, tell His Honour freely.” “I?” She turned away. “What can I say? Saying it would be useless. It can't be done.” “Why?” Hu pressed. “How do you know it can't?” She turned back, frowning, her lips closed and long eyelashes fluttering in apparent indecision. Several times she seemed about to speak, but finally only sighed and shook her head, setting her earrings swaying.

zh: “有话尽管说呀！”王有龄拉住了她的手说，“只要我办得到，一定如你的愿，就办不到，我也一定说理由给你听。不要紧，说出来商量。”“跟哪个商量？只好跟皇帝老爷商量！”“皇帝老爷”的称呼，在王有龄颇有新奇之感，特别是出以吴侬软语，更觉别有意趣，便即笑道：“有那么了不起，非要皇帝才能有办法？”“自然罗！”畹香似乎觉得自己极有理，“除非皇帝老爷有圣旨，让你高升到上海来做官……”原来千回百折，不过要表明舍不得与王有龄相离这句话。本主儿此时不会有所表示，敲边鼓的开口了。“畹香！”胡雪岩问道：“你是心里的话？”“啊呀，胡老爷。”畹香的神色显得很郑重，“是不是要我把心剜出来给你看。”“我相信，我相信！”王有龄急忙安慰地说。
en: “Say whatever you wish,” Wang urged, taking her hand. “If I can do it, I will. If I can't, I'll explain why. Don't worry; we can discuss it.” “With whom? Only His Majesty the Emperor!” Her form of address for the emperor struck Wang as novel, especially in her soft southern accent. He smiled. “Is it so momentous that only the emperor can solve it?” “Naturally!” She seemed entirely convinced. “Unless His Majesty issues an edict promoting you to an appointment in Shanghai...” After all these turns, she merely wished to say she could not bear to be parted from him. Wang himself offered no answer for the moment; his helper spoke. “Wanxiang, do you mean that sincerely?” “Oh, Mr Hu!” She looked very solemn. “Must I cut out my heart and show it to you?” “I believe you, I believe you!” Wang hastened to reassure her.

zh: “我也相信。”胡雪岩笑嘻嘻地接口：“畹香，初七你跟王大老爷一船回杭州，好不好？““怎么不好！只怕王大老爷不肯。”“千肯万肯，求之不得！只有三天工夫了，你预备起来！”这话连王有龄都有些诧异，为何胡雪岩这等冒失，替人硬作主纳妾？但以对他发解甚深，暂且不响，静观究竟。王有龄尚县如此，畹香自然格外困惑，而且也有些惊惶，怕弄假成真，变得骑虎难下。“怎么样？是我们当面锣，对面鼓，直接来谈，还是由我找三阿姨去谈？或者请尤五哥出面？“这是谈“身价”，越发象真了！畹香不断眨着眼，神态尴尬，但她到底不是初出道的雏儿，正一正脸色，坐了下来，带些欣慰的口气答道：“蛮好！我自家的身体，自己来谈好了。我先要请问王大老爷是怎么个意思？“
en: “So do I,” Hu put in with a smile. “Wanxiang, why not return to Hangzhou on the same boat as His Honour on the seventh?” “Why wouldn't I? I'm only afraid he wouldn't agree.” “He agrees a thousand times over. He could wish for nothing better! There are only three days left. Begin your preparations.” Even Wang was surprised. Why was Hu so rashly deciding on another man's behalf that he should take a concubine? But knowing him well, he said nothing and watched. If Wang was surprised, Wanxiang was more bewildered still—and alarmed that pretence might become reality, leaving her unable to retreat. “Well?” Hu asked. “Shall we discuss it directly, face to face? Shall I speak to Third Aunt? Or should Brother You intervene?” Now he was talking about the price of releasing her. It sounded more real than ever. Wanxiang blinked repeatedly and looked awkward, but she was no novice. Composing herself, she sat down and answered with a suggestion of gratification. “Very well. It's my own person; I can negotiate for myself. First, may I ask what His Honour has in mind?”

zh: 王有龄怎么说得出来？当然是胡雪岩代答，“王大老爷怎么个意思，你还不明白？”他这样反问，而其实是一句遁词，他最初就是使的一句诈语，目的是要试探畹香对王有龄究有几许感情？经此一番折冲，心中已经有数，这时倒是要问一问王有龄了。“我当然明白。”畹香接着他的话，“不过我不敢说出来。自己想想没有那么好的福气。”这一下连王有龄也明白了，如果想把她置于侧室，恐怕未必如愿，他怕谈下去会出现窘境，彼此无趣，便即宕开一句：“慢慢再谈吧！先吃酒。”这句话与胡雪岩心思正相符，他也觉得畹香的本心已够明白，这方面不须再谈，所以附和着说：“对啊！吃酒，吃酒。有话回头你们到枕上去谈。”畹香见此光景，知道自己落了下风。看样子王有龄亦并无真心，早知如此，落得把话说漂亮些，如今变得人家在暗处，自己在亮处，想趁这三天工夫敲王有龄一个竹杠，只怕办不到了。这都是上了胡雪岩的当！畹香委屈在心，化作一脸幽怨，默默无言地，使得王有龄大生怜惜之心。
en: How could Wang possibly answer? Naturally, Hu replied for him. “Don't you already know what he has in mind?” It was an evasion. His original proposal had been a bluff to test the depth of Wanxiang's feeling for Wang. Their exchanges had now given him a fair idea. It was time to discover Wang's wishes instead. “Of course I know,” she answered. “But I don't dare say it aloud. I can't imagine being so fortunate.” Now even Wang understood that, if he wished to take her as a concubine, she might not agree. Fearing that further discussion would embarrass them both, he put the matter aside. “We can talk about it later. Let us drink first.” That suited Hu exactly. He too thought her intentions sufficiently clear and saw no need to pursue the subject. “Yes, let's drink. You can discuss the rest in bed later.” Wanxiang knew she had lost the advantage. Apparently Wang had no serious intention either. Had she known, she could have made a more generous declaration. Now his position remained concealed while hers was exposed. Her hope of extracting a large sum during the remaining three days would probably come to nothing. Hu had tricked her into this. The grievance in her heart became a mournful expression and silence, which greatly stirred Wang's pity.

zh: “怎么？”他轻轻抚着她的肩问：“一下子不高兴了？”这一向，畹香索性哭了，“嗯哼”一声，用手绢掩着脸，飞快地后后房奔了进去，接着便是很轻的“息率、息率”的声音传了出来。王有龄听得哭声，心里有些难过，自然更多的是感动，要想有所表示，却让胡雪岩阻止住了，“不要理她！”他轻声说道，“她们的眼泪不值钱，一想起伤心的事就会哭一场，不见得是此刻受了委屈！”听了他的话，王有龄爽然若失，觉得他的持论过苛，只是为了表示对他信服，便点点头，坐着不动。
en: “What is it?” he asked, gently touching her shoulder. “Why are you suddenly unhappy?” At the question, she gave herself up to tears. With a sob, she covered her face with her handkerchief and hurried into the back room. Soft weeping followed. Wang felt distressed and, still more, moved. He wanted to do something, but Hu stopped him. “Leave her,” he said quietly. “Their tears are easily shed. Whenever they remember something painful, they can have a cry. It doesn't necessarily mean she's been hurt just now.” Wang felt suddenly bereft. He thought Hu's judgement too harsh, but nodded and remained seated to show his confidence in him.

zh: “雪公！”胡雪岩问道，“你把你的意思说给我听，我替你办。”“我的意思……”王有龄沉吟了好半天才说出来：“如果把她弄回家去，怕引起物议。”他对畹香恋恋之意，已很显然。胡雪岩觉得他为“官声”着想，态度是不错的，不过也不妨进一步点破：“畹香恐怕也未见得肯到杭州去，讨回家去这一层，大可不必想它。照我看，雪公以后总常有到上海来的时候，不妨置作外室。春二三月，或者秋天西湖风景好的时候，把她接到杭州去住一阵子，我另外替雪公安排‘小房子’。你看如何？”“好，好，”王有龄深惬所怀，“就拜托你跟她谈一谈，看要花多少钱？”“那不过每月贴她些开销。至于每趟来，另外送她钱，或是替她打道饰、做衣裳，那是你们自己的情分，旁人无法过问。“这到这里，胡雪岩向里喊了声：”畹香！“
en: “Mr Xuexuan, tell me what you want, and I'll arrange it.” “What I want...” Wang paused for a long while. “If I brought her home, I'm afraid people would talk.” His attachment was plain. Hu thought it right that he should consider his official reputation, but felt the point should be made more clearly. “Wanxiang may not want to go to Hangzhou either, so there's no need to consider bringing her into your household. I expect you'll often be coming to Shanghai. Why not keep her in a separate establishment? In the second or third month of spring, or in autumn when West Lake is at its best, you could bring her to Hangzhou for a while. I'd arrange a small house for you. What do you think?” “Excellent!” This exactly suited Wang. “Please discuss it with her and find out what it would cost.” “It would only mean contributing to her monthly expenses. Any extra money you give her when you visit, or jewellery and clothes you have made for her, would be a matter between you two. Nobody else could intervene.” Then Hu called, “Wanxiang!”

zh: 畹香慢慢走了出来，得新匀过脂粉，但眼圈依旧是红的，一副楚楚可怜的样子，偎坐在王有龄身旁，含颦不语。“刚才哭什么？”王有龄问道，“哪个得罪你了？”“嗳！雪公，这话问得多余。”胡雪岩在一边接口，“畹香的心事，你还不明白？要跟你到杭州，舍不得三阿姨，不跟你去，心里又不愿。左右为难，自然要伤心。畹香，我的话说对了没有？”畹香不答他的话，转脸对王有龄说：“你看你，枉为我们相好了一场，你还不如胡老爷明白。”“这是旁观者清！”王有龄跟她说着话，却向胡雪岩使了个眼色。意思是要他把商量好的办法提出来。胡雪岩微一颔首，表示会意，同时还报以眼色，请他避开。“我有些头晕，到你床上去靠一靠。”等王有龄歪倒在后房畹香床上，胡雪岩便跟畹香展开了谈判，问她一个月要多少开销？
en: She came out slowly. Her powder and rouge had been renewed, but her eyes were still red. Looking fragile and pitiful, she sat close to Wang, frowning slightly and saying nothing. “What were you crying about?” he asked. “Who offended you?” “Ah, Mr Xuexuan, there's no need to ask,” Hu interposed. “Don't you understand her difficulty? If she goes to Hangzhou with you, she can't bear to leave Third Aunt. If she stays, she doesn't want to be parted from you. Torn between the two, she naturally feels unhappy. Am I right, Wanxiang?” Instead of answering him, she turned to Wang. “Just look at you. After all we've meant to each other, you understand less than Mr Hu.” “The bystander sees more clearly,” Wang said, while signalling to Hu to propose their arrangement. Hu gave a slight nod, then returned a glance asking him to leave them alone. “I'm a little dizzy,” Wang said. “I'll lie down on your bed for a while.” Once he had stretched out in the back room, Hu began negotiating with Wanxiang. How much did she need each month?

zh: “过日子是省的，一个月最多二三十两银子。”“倘或王大老爷一个月帮你三十两银子，你不是就可以关起门来过清静日子了？”“那是再好都没有。不过……”畹香摇摇头，不肯再说下去。“说呀！”胡雪岩问道：“是不是有债务？不妨说来听听。”“真的，再没有比胡老爷更明白的人！”畹香答道：“哪个不想从良？实在有许多难处，跟别人说了，只以为狮子大开口，说出来反而伤感情，不如不说。“
en: “I live quite frugally. Twenty or thirty taels at most.” “If His Honour gave you thirty taels a month, could you close your door to visitors and live quietly?” “Nothing could be better. But...” She shook her head and stopped. “Go on,” Hu urged. “Do you have debts? You may tell me.” “Truly, nobody is more understanding than you, Mr Hu. Who wouldn't wish to leave this life? But there are so many difficulties. If one tells other people, they think one is asking for an outrageous sum. Speaking only harms the friendship. Better to say nothing.”

zh: 听这语气，开出口来的数目不会小，如果说有一万八千的债务，是不是替她还呢？胡雪岩也曾听闻过，有所谓“淴浴”一说，负债累累的红倌人，抓住一个冤大头，枕边海誓山盟，非他不嫁，于是花巨万银子替她还债赎身，真个量珠聘去，而此红倌人从了良，早则半载，晚则一年，必定不安于室，想尽花样，下堂求去，原来一开始就是个骗局。看畹香还不致如此。但依了她的要求，叫她杜门谢客。怕未见得能言行一致，招蜂引蝶之余，说起来还是“王某某的外室”，反例坏了王有龄的名声。这不是太傻了吗？因此，他笑一笑说：“既然你有许多难处，自然不好勉强，不过你要晓得，王大老爷对你，倒确是真情一片。”“我也知道，人心都是肉做的。而况有尤五少的面子，我也不敢不巴结，只要王大老爷在这里一天，我一定尽心伺候。”
en: From that tone, the sum would not be small. If she claimed debts of eighteen thousand taels, should they pay them? Hu had heard of a practice called “taking a bath.” A popular courtesan burdened with debts would seize upon a wealthy fool, swear eternal love beside his pillow, and declare that she would marry nobody else. He would spend a fortune paying her debts and buying her release, as though purchasing a bride with pearls. Yet within six months, or a year at most, she would grow restless in married life and devise every means of leaving him. It had been a scheme from the beginning. Wanxiang did not appear quite that sort. Still, even if her demands were met and she agreed to stop receiving clients, her conduct might not match her promise. If she continued attracting admirers while known as Wang's mistress, his reputation would suffer. Wouldn't that be foolish? Hu therefore smiled. “If you have so many difficulties, naturally we can't press you. But you should know that His Honour's feeling for you is quite sincere.” “I know. We all have hearts. Besides, with Fifth Master You's standing to consider, I could hardly fail to do my best. As long as His Honour is here, I shall certainly attend to him wholeheartedly.”

zh: “到底是见过世面的！说出话来与那些初出道的小姑娘不同。”胡雪岩这样赞她，“我也算是个‘媒人’，说话要替两方面着想。畹香，我看你跟王大老爷，一年做两三次短期夫妻好了。”她大致懂得他的意思，却故意问一句：“怎么做法？”“譬如说，王大老爷到上海来，就住在你这里，当然，你要脱空身子来陪他。或者，高兴了，接你到杭州去烧烧香，逛逛西湖，不又是做了一阵短期夫妻。至于平常的开销，一个月贴你二十五两银子，另外总还有些点缀，多多少少，要看你自己的手腕。”这个办法当然可以接受，“就怕一层，万一王大老爷到上海来，我正好不空。”畹香踌躇着说，“那时候会为难。立了这个门口，来的都是衣食父母，哪个也得罪不起。胡老爷，我这是实话，你不要见气。”“我就是喜欢听实话。”胡雪岩说，“万一前客不让后客，也有个办法，那时你以王太太的身分，陪王大老爷住栈房，这面只说回乡下去了。掉这样一个枪花行不行？”怎么不行？畹香的难题解决，颇为高兴，娇声笑道：“真正的，胡老爷，你倒象是吃过我们这一行的饭，真会掉枪花！”
en: “You've clearly seen something of the world,” Hu praised her. “You speak differently from girls just entering the profession. I suppose I count as a matchmaker, and must consider both sides. Wanxiang, I think you and His Honour should be husband and wife for short periods, two or three times a year.” She broadly understood, but deliberately asked, “How would that work?” “For example, when he comes to Shanghai, he stays here. Naturally, you make yourself available to keep him company. Or, if he wishes, he brings you to Hangzhou to offer incense and see West Lake. Again, you'd be husband and wife for a little while. For ordinary expenses, he'd contribute twenty-five taels a month. There would certainly be extras as well; how much would depend on your own skill.” This was certainly acceptable. “Only one thing worries me. What if His Honour arrives while I'm occupied?” she asked hesitantly. “That would be awkward. Once one sets up in this business, every visitor provides one's livelihood. I can't afford to offend any of them. Mr Hu, I'm speaking frankly. Please don't be angry.” “Frankness is precisely what I like. If an earlier guest won't make way for a later one, there's still a solution. You can stay at an inn with His Honour as Mrs Wang and tell people here that you've gone to the country. Would that manoeuvre work?” Of course it would. Her difficulty solved, Wanxiang was delighted. “Really, Mr Hu, one would think you'd worked in our profession yourself. You know all the tricks!”

zh: “那我替你做‘相帮，好不好？”妓家的规矩，女仆未婚的称“大姐”，已婚的称“娘姨”，男仆则叫做“相帮”。听胡雪岩这一说，畹香才发觉自己大大失言了，哪一行的饭都好吃，说吃这一行饭，无异辱人妻女，遇到脾气不好的客人，尤其是北方人，开到这样的玩笑，当时就可以翻脸，所以她涨得满脸通红，赶紧道歉。“胡老爷，大人不记小人过，我说错了话，真正该打。”她握着他的手，拼命推着揉着，不断他说，“胡老爷，你千万不能见气，你要如何罚我都可以，只不能生气。”声音太大，把王有龄惊动了，忍不住走出来张望，只见胡雪岩微笑不语，畹香惶恐满面地在赔罪，越觉诧异。等到说明经过，彼此一笑而罢。这时畹香的态度又不同了，自觉别具身分，对王胡之间，主客之分，更加明显。王有龄当然能够感觉得到，仿佛在自己家里那样，丝毫不觉拘束，因而洗杯更酌，酒兴越发好了。
en: “Then shall I become your male attendant?” In a courtesan household, an unmarried female servant was called an elder sister, a married one an aunt, and a male servant an attendant. Only at his reply did Wanxiang realise her serious mistake. One could speak of working in any other trade, but to say that a man had worked in hers amounted to insulting the women of his family. An ill-tempered client, especially a northerner, might take immediate offence. She blushed deeply and hurried to apologise. “Mr Hu, a great man overlooks a small person's fault. I spoke wrongly. I truly deserve a beating.” Taking his hand, she pressed and rubbed it, repeatedly saying, “You mustn't be angry. Punish me however you wish, but please don't be angry.” Her voice grew loud enough to disturb Wang, who could not resist coming out to see what was happening. Hu was smiling silently while Wanxiang apologised in alarm. Wang was more puzzled still. Once the incident was explained, they all laughed and let it pass. Wanxiang's manner changed again. She felt that she now occupied a distinct position, and the division between Wang as host and Hu as guest became more pronounced. Wang naturally sensed it. He felt as unrestrained as though in his own home. They rinsed their cups, poured more wine, and drank with renewed pleasure.

zh: “雪岩，我也要问你句话，”他兴味盎然地说，“听说阿珠一颗心都在你身上。到底怎么回事？”胡雪岩还未开口，畹香抢着问道：阿珠是谁？““你问他自己。”王有龄指着胡雪岩说。“船家的一个小姑娘。”他说，“我现在没有心思搞这些花样。”语焉不详，未能满足畹香的好奇心，她磨着王有龄细说根由。他也就把听来的话，加油加酱地说了给她听。中间有说得太离谱的，胡雪岩才补充一两句，作为纠正，小小的出入就不去管他了。
en: “Xueyan, I have something to ask you too,” Wang said with lively interest. “I hear A'zhu's heart is entirely yours. What is going on?” Before Hu could answer, Wanxiang asked, “Who is A'zhu?” “Ask him.” Wang pointed to Hu. “The boatman's daughter,” Hu replied. “I have no mind for that sort of thing at present.” This vague explanation did not satisfy her curiosity. She pressed Wang for the full story, and he repeated what he had heard, adding considerable embellishment. Where he strayed too far from the facts, Hu corrected him with a word or two. Minor discrepancies he let pass.

zh: “这好啊！”畹香十分好事，“胡老爷我来替你做媒，好不好？”此言一出，不独胡雪岩，连王有龄亦颇有匪夷所思之感，“你跟人家又不认识，”他说，“这个媒怎么做法？”“不认识怕什么？”畹香答道，“看样子，这件好事要阿珠的娘点头，才会成功，而且阿珠好象也有心理，对你们爷们，她是不肯说的，只有我去，才能弄得清楚。”王有龄觉得她的话很有理，点点头问：“雪岩，你看如何？就让畹香来试一试吧！”“多谢，多谢！”胡雪岩说，“慢慢再看。”
en: “Why, that's splendid!” Wanxiang was eager to intervene. “Mr Hu, shall I be your matchmaker?” Not only Hu but Wang found the proposal extraordinary. “You don't even know her,” Wang said. “How could you arrange it?” “What does that matter? From the sound of it, the match depends upon her mother's agreement. And A'zhu seems to have something on her mind that she won't tell you men. Only if I go can we discover what it is.” Wang thought this reasonable. Nodding, he asked, “What do you say, Xueyan? Let Wanxiang try.” “Thank you, thank you,” Hu answered. “We'll see later.”

zh: “我知道了。”畹香故意激他，“ ‘痴心女子负心汉’，胡老爷一定不喜欢她！”“这你可是冤枉他了。”王有龄笑着说，“胡老爷一有空就躲在船上，与阿珠有说不完的话。”“既如此还不接回家去？莫非大太太厉害？”“那可以另外租房子，住在外面。”“对啊！”畹香逼视着胡雪岩问：“胡老爷，易求无价宝，难得有情人！”“我也这么想。”王有龄接着便提高了声音念道：“ ‘是前生注定事，莫错过姻缘’！”两个人一吹一唱，交替着劝他，他已打定了主意，但有许多话不便当着畹香说，所以只是含笑摇头。看他既不受劝，畹香也只好废然而罢。
en: “I understand.” Wanxiang deliberately provoked him. “A devoted woman and a faithless man! You must not care for her.” “Now you're wronging him,” Wang laughed. “Whenever he has a free moment, he hides away on the boat. He and A'zhu never run out of things to say.” “Then why doesn't he take her home? Is the first wife formidable?” “He could rent another house and let her live separately.” “Exactly!” Wanxiang looked directly at Hu. “Priceless treasure is easier to find than a loving heart.” “That's what I think too.” Wang raised his voice and recited, “What was ordained in a former life—do not let the destined marriage pass!” They urged him on in turn, each supporting the other. Hu had made up his mind, but there was much he could not say in Wanxiang's presence. He only smiled and shook his head. Seeing that he would not be persuaded, she finally abandoned the attempt.
